description.value:
Duration constant

The flat check to end persistent damage on you is DC 10 rather than DC 15, and you may attempt that check at the start of your turn as well as at the end of it. If someone assists you, the assisted DC drops by a further 2 rather than the usual amount.

cinderfall.incomplete: The flat-check-to-end-persistent-damage DC reduction to 10 is confirmed real and directly matches pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/ancestry/dwarf/level-1/fire-savvy.json's own ItemAlteration itemType:"condition" property:"pd-recovery-dc" mode:"downgrade" shape exactly (that card scopes to fire only via a predicate; this card is unconditional, so the predicate is simply omitted). "Attemptable at the start of your turn too" (a check-timing change) and "an assisted DC drops a further 2" (a dynamic, conditional DC reduction) remain unbuilt -- no rule element changes when a flat check may be attempted, and no rule element conditions a DC reduction on being assisted.
